card.name: Words leading up to "logged in"
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected "logged in" or "log in", such as "be", "are", "log" or "signed", in website messages saying a user must be logged in or signed in to see or do something.

modes.label: Must be logged in
modes.description: Helping words like "be" or "are" right before "logged in" in access requirements.
modes.example: please click here (note: you must<< be>> logged in to view this page

modes.label: Log in / sign up
modes.description: The word "log" or "signed" in prompts to log in, register or sign up.
modes.example: To start a discussion topic about this article, please<< log>> in or register.|

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict login-related words such as "login" and "登录" next.
